meta.title: Makeborne daily actuals log (template)
meta.howToUse: Copy this file to a private location (NOT this repo if it is public), then add one entry per channel per day to entries. Leave a field null when it is unknown; never type 0 for unknown. Totals are computed by the dashboard, not typed in.
meta.privacy: Aggregate numbers only. Never log buyer names, emails, Whop IDs, payment IDs, creator contact details or screenshots with personal data.

sourcesOfTruth.spend: Owner's payment records (creator payouts, boosts, listings) by budget line id b1-b9, or 'revenue' for reinvested money
sourcesOfTruth.impressions: Platform analytics (boosts and paid posts only)
sourcesOfTruth.views: Platform analytics (TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, X; creator screenshots for creator posts)
sourcesOfTruth.clicks: /go/ redirect log for that channel's codes (UTM)
sourcesOfTruth.signups: App DB account_created with that first-touch source
sourcesOfTruth.checkouts: App DB checkout_opened (Makeborne-created checkouts) for accounts with that first-touch source
sourcesOfTruth.paid: Whop payment.succeeded (first payments) joined to the account's first touch; gross, before refunds
sourcesOfTruth.refunds: Whop refund.created for first payments, dated on the refund day
sourcesOfTruth.revenue: Whop usd_total of first payments that day, gross of fees; renewals go in channel 'renewals'

entrySchema.spend: number, USD cash spent that day on this channel (null if none)
entrySchema.paid: integer or null (gross new paying accounts)
entrySchema.revenue: number or null (USD, first payments, gross of fees)
entrySchema.notes: string: post ids or hook codes (e.g. tt-0412-r2), creator handle code, beat tag (beat:images), anything unusual

optional.activated: integer or null (north-star payers from this day's cohort, filled in 7 days later)
optional.studioOrScale: integer or null (paid on Studio or Scale)
optional.checkouts: integer or null (checkouts opened that day by accounts from this channel)
